hotels.title: Newly-Renovated Hawaii Oceanfront Haven on Kauai Island with Daily US$50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Tucked away on the secluded shores of Nukoli'i Beach, this OUTRIGGER island paradise has emerged from a complete renovation as one of Kauai's most polished beachfront addresses. The freshly remodelled rooms, four sparkling pools and island-inspired interiors all embody the lush natural beauty that defines the Garden Isle. Start each day with a leisurely breakfast at Ocean House before making a splash in the resort's aquatic playground, where a cascading waterfall, 75-foot waterslide and sand-bottom pool await. Spend afternoons at Driftwood Beachfront Bar with a cocktail in hand and the soothing sound of the Pacific waves, then finish the day with oceanfront dining at Ocean House by legendary Hawaii chef Roy Yamaguchi. Cultural moments weave through your stay, from the E Ala E sunrise ceremony on the beach to the poolside E Komo Mai Aloha Friday celebration. Beyond the resort, the Wailua River and a number of spectacular attractions lie just a short drive away.

hotels.title: Laidback Kauai Oceanfront Luxury with Three Restaurants & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Treat yourself to quintessential laidback luxury on Kauai island's eastern coast. This tropical paradise offers direct access to the pristine sands of Nukolii Beach, while the resort's spa invites relaxation with traditional Hawaiian treatments. Savour island-inspired cuisine at the three onsite restaurants, or explore the nearby Wailua River, famed for its kayaking and paddleboarding.
